result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback E&O limit and the preferred cyber limit, and retains statutory workers’ compensation and certificates on request. However, it does not require the CGL coverage to be USD 1 million per occurrence and USD 2 million aggregate. It also unnecessarily expands the cyber trigger to vendors that merely access Company systems, whereas the playbook applies it to vendors processing Customer Data, and it uses the less precise term “Company data.”
